rule: passes if the simulated chance of a false alarm in a normal year is at most 6% both at the simulated and at the real holiday scale (Gaussian AR(1) noise, phi = 0.4, holidays in the data, the set-up's own threshold rule)
passes if, at a matched 20% background, the gain for a 20% drop lasting 14 days and for a lasting 20% drop both have 95% intervals (three-month blocks) above zero

supports (tick) if the episodes caught under a rule have p (adjusted, best of the monitor's family) below 0.05; beats chance alone (tick in brackets) if only p (own) is below 0.05; does not support otherwise
